shortDescription: Retrieve AzureAD Objects from Azure AD Server.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: azure_ad_name
options.description: Name of the Azure AD Server where to search for objects.

options.name: azure_ad_uid
options.description: Unique identifier of the Azure AD Server where to search for objects.

options.name: details_level
options.description: Standard and Full description are the same.

options.name: domains_to_process
options.description: Indicates which domains to process the commands on. It cannot be used with the details-level full, must be run from the System Domain only and with ignore-warnings true. Valid values are, CURRENT_DOMAIN, ALL_DOMAINS_ON_THIS_SERVER.

options.name: filter
options.description: Return results matching the specified filter.

options.name: limit
options.description: The maximal number of returned results.

options.name: offset
options.description: Number of the results to initially skip.

options.name: order
options.description: Sorts the results by search criteria. Automatically sorts the results by Name, in the ascending order.

options.name: uid_in_azure_ad
options.description: Return result matching the unique identifier of the object on the Azure AD Server.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
